basis: Provider capabilities and public pricing docs reviewed 2026-11-10; owner credit routing updated 2026-11-23 and the Deepgram Flux rate re-checked that day. Balances named on lanes below date from 2026-11-03 to 2026-11-06 and are stale: a balance older than a week, or missing, is unknown. Read the live balance where each lane says and record it in the private credits ledger before a paid run.
rules: Before any paid generation, name the owning entity, read its live balance, and use the provider with the most usable credit for it. Credits fund only their own entity and are used before pay-as-you-go spend; a credit is not permission to raise a spending cap.

Live Runware catalogue (2026-11-10): Seedream 5.5 is coming-soon; do not route or infer production availability from its public model page. MiniMax H3 Image promotion covers 4K only until November 17. MiniMax H3 Lite/Highspeed video pricing is promotional until December 31; P-Video-2-Pro-Replace discount until November 19 is for person replacement, not general text-to-video; Kling 4.0 Flash 15% discount expires November 10. Always re-quote live schemas and never hardcode promotions as evergreen defaults.

Allow photorealistic synthetic people of any age, fictional patients, families, clinicians, unblurred synthetic data and fully designed speculative UIs where the story calls for them. No automatic blur or age restriction. Label proposed functionality rather than treating it as verified current behavior; live-product proof uses source-hashed capture.

Do not interpret route_media.py sorting by status/free as an actual numerical lowest-cost model ranking. It discovers usable lanes; model selection also requires current per-model price, actual task/configuration, truth/quality verification and consent. Read skills/produce/references/provider-cost-quality-routing.md.

For Runware model research, use scripts/quote-runware-models.mjs against the canonical live model index and schemas with no key/spend; if pricing needs configuration or GPU-time measurements, report manual-quote instead of guessing. A quote does not authorize generation.

AssemblyAI generates speech (TTS-1 stock voices and consented cloned voices) and analyzes speech, including a second transcript or timestamp opinion when explicitly requested; it does not generate images or video. ElevenLabs offers premium voice and music/effects/ASR candidates; use it only with a written reason in the job, through the governed adapter and the owner's authorization.

For every creative asset choose the approved film mode and storyboard goal first, then compare accepted media and available generation on equal quality and cost. Fully synthetic image/video/3D/UI and human scenes may be the whole movie in vision, fiction, abstract or conceptual modes. Only factual demonstrations of current functionality require real capture.
Cheapest lane that passes QA wins for a picture. A free picture lane (Remotion kit, Lottie, hand-drawn SVG, Playwright capture) beats any paid picture lane. Voice has no free lane.

For new narration, use scripts/narration-preflight.mjs to check current rates and available funding. Stock (non-cloned) voices come from Deepgram Flux (flux-sienna-en or flux-haley-en, MahumTech project) for every film except ABACare, then MahumTech Azure Speech, then OpenAI. ABACare films use AssemblyAI stock voices on ABACare credit. Voice clones of Sarosh, or of Syeda F. Abidi from her own recorded consent, are for personal or ABACare films only and use AssemblyAI cloned voices (owner direction 2026-11-23). Preserve accepted takes and explicitly pinned casts. Marin on Azure OpenAI is gated for directed narration. MAI remains in public preview. It and the other documented Azure candidates stay gated. Windows Narrator, SAPI, System.Speech, OneCore, edge-tts, espeak, say and HeyGen stock avatar voices are forbidden. If the governed route cannot run, deliver the cut silent with the lines on screen.

MahumTech Azure (mt-foundary-resource) is the image default for every entity except ABACare and the speech fallback after Deepgram. ABACare images use the OpenAI ABACare org grant until it expires on 2026-11-26, then Runware API credit. New narration follows the live narration preflight.

ElevenLabs is never a recipe default; use it only with a written reason in the job, through the governed adapter. Clones: Sarosh, and Syeda F. Abidi from her own recorded consent, for personal or ABACare films only, through AssemblyAI cloned voices. An ElevenLabs clone of the same two people for those films needs a written reason. The only other clone is the owner PVC on Eleven v4 for the manifest-named Deloitte pursuit films for Revolva, Empowera and CoLedger (owner direction 2026-11-03). Deepgram has no self-serve cloning, so it is not a clone route.
Higgsfield, Runway and Google Vertex spend stays frozen until the owner approves it in the current task. The funded generative-video lane is IrukaDark (approved hero shots only).
Local AI is off on this PC: no local models, TTS, STT or embedders. Self-hosted models on cloud GPUs are allowed inside the compute caps.

The owner picks the entity each film is made for; name it in the quote and never stop on ownership. Credits pay only for their own entity. Personal films have no credit pool of their own: they use the AssemblyAI clone (ABACare account) and Deepgram stock voices (MahumTech project), and that spend is logged as personal.
Do not introduce a provider merely because a key or a startup credit exists for it.

Every lane is exposed to the agent, including by-hand ones: run route_media.py --catalog to see all of them with their mode (script, api, connector or browser) and status. A browser lane is driven through Claude in Chrome on the owner's already signed-in session; never enter credentials or card details, ask before each download, and judge the file before it is accepted.
A frozen lane is listed with what would unfreeze it. Frozen means the owner has not approved that spend in this task, not that the capability is hidden.
Anything marked draftOnly is research or a rough pass. It is never the delivered picture or voice.
